units.source_text: 源氏太政大臣于未时来到马场殿。

en.t: Genji, the Grand Minister, came to the riding grounds pavilion at the hour of the Goat.
Sure enough, all the imperial princes had already arrived.

units.source_text: 这里的骑射竞赛，方式与朝廷行事不同，近卫府里的中将、少将等都来参加，花样都很新鲜，愉快地玩了一天。

en.t: The mounted archery contest here was conducted differently from court ceremonies; middle captains and lesser captains of the Palace Guards all took part, the arrangements were novel, and everyone spent the day in cheerful amusement.

units.source_text: 女子们对于骑射之事，毫无知识。

en.t: The women knew nothing at all about mounted archery.

units.source_text: 但她们看见皇族的近侍们也都打扮得鲜艳夺目，拼命地竞赛胜负，颇感兴趣。

en.t: But when they saw even the attendants of the imperial family dressed in brilliant finery and competing fiercely for victory, they found it quite interesting.

units.source_text: 马场很宽广，一直通到紫姬所居的南院，那里的青年侍女也都出来观赏骑射。

en.t: The riding ground was very broad and extended all the way to the southern residence where Lady Murasaki lived, so the young waiting women there also came out to watch the mounted archery.

units.source_text: 竞赛之时，乐队奏《打球乐》及《纳苏利》。

en.t: During the contest, the musicians played Dagiu Music and Nasori.
When the winners and losers were decided, bells were struck and drums were beaten.

units.source_text: 直到天黑，一切都看不见了，方始赛毕。

en.t: Only after darkness fell and nothing could be seen did the contest finally end.

units.source_text: 近侍们各按等级领受奖品。

en.t: The attendants each received prizes according to their rank.

units.source_text: 到了夜色很深的时候，各人方始散去。

en.t: When the night had grown very deep, everyone finally dispersed.
